problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on win-win solutions and understanding the needs of both parties to create value.

episode_summary: Eirik Gislason discusses the critical role of negotiation in real estate, emphasizing win-win strategies and the importance of understanding client needs. He explores the impact of AI on the industry, suggesting that while AI can enhance efficiency, human negotiation skills remain invaluable. The episode also covers tactics for handling difficult client conversations and the importance of a tailored value proposition.
